fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 6% of Gross Revenue per month, paid weekly (Tuesday), with a minimum of $250 per week ($1,083.33/month equivalent) applying after the second year of operations. Marketing Fee is 2% of Gross Revenue, paid on the same weekly schedule. Local Advertising Requirement is at least $2,000 per month. MarTech Fee is currently $0/month but may be increased up to $500/month with 30 days' notice. Cooperative Advertising minimum is $1,500/month when established (counts toward local advertising requirement after 12 months open). Technology Fee is $200/month, may increase up to $1,000/month cap. POS and Text Messaging Systems fee is currently $499/month (third party). Bookkeeping Software (third party) currently $250/month for services plus $20/month for QuickBooks Online Simple Start. Email, Microsoft Office 365, and Antivirus Software currently $18-$25/month and $4-$6/month respectively (third party). Music License Fees $29-$54/month (third party). Convention/Continuing Education Enrollment Fee currently $500 per attendee, capped at $2,500. Additional Training and Assistance $300/day per individual plus travel/lodging/dining costs.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fee | 6% of Gross Revenue per month. After your second year of operations, a minimum Royalty Fee of $250 per week will be applied. | On Tuesday of each week based on the Gross Revenue generated by the Franchised Business during the preceding Business Week (Monday through Sunday). | Your Royalty Fee will begin once your Franchised Business opens. See Note 2 for the definition of Gross Revenue.
Marketing Fee | 2% of Gross Revenue | Same interval and manner as your weekly Royalty Fee. | We may collect your Marketing Fee in the same manner as we collect your Royalty Fee. See Item 11. See Note 2 for the definition of Gross Revenue.
Local Advertising Requirement | At least $2,000 per month, beginning with the month prior to opening and continuing during the duration or ownership | As incurred | You must spend at least $2,000 each month in your local market in advertising.
MarTech Fee | Currently, $0 per month per Store | Not currently charged | The MarTech fee is considered a component of the Local Advertising requirement but is collected by the Home Office in conjunction with Marketing Fee. We reserve the right to increase this fee in relationship to direct expenses with 30 days' notice, provided it will not exceed $500 per month.
Cooperative Advertising | At least $1,500 per month, when established | Monthly, currently the 5th of the month | ...
Technology Fee | $200 per month per Store as of the date of this Disclosure Document; provided we may increase this fee to cover our then-current costs... We reserve the right to increase this fee, provided it will not exceed $1,000 per month.
Point of Sale (POS) and Text Messaging Systems | Currently, $499 per month | As incurred | This fee is imposed by us but payable to a third party.
Bookkeeping Software | Currently $250 per month for services; QuickBooks Online currently $20 per month for Simple Start plan | As incurred | Payable to third parties.
Email, Microsoft Office 365, and Antivirus Software | Currently, $18 to $25 per month for Email and Office 365; and $4 to $6 per month for antivirus software | As incurred | Payable to third parties.
Music License Fees | $29 to $54 per month | As incurred | Required by us but paid to a third party.
Convention or Continuing Education Enrollment Fee | Currently, $500 per attendee | Before Convention | May increase, will not exceed $2,500 per attendee.
Additional Training and Assistance | $300 per day for each individual, plus reimbursement of travel, lodging and dining costs | Before assistance |
